newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Death toll from Pakistan gas leak rises to 21.
newsitem.headline: Death toll from Pakistan gas leak rises to 21.

text.p: The death toll from a poison gas spillage in the Pakistani city of Lahore rose to 21 on Thursday, hospital doctors said.

More than 700 people were taken to various hospitals after a gas, which doctors said was ammonia, leaked from cylinders being carried on a truck through the populous Mughalpura district of the Punjab provincial capital on Wednesday evening.
"People started rushing out of their houses choking," a witness said, describing scenes of panic. "Some fell unconscious and nobody was in a position to help the other."
Reporters who toured the locality in the early hours said the gas had largely dispersed, although an acrid smell remained.
Police and troops were patrolling the streets in gas masks and the bodies of many animals, including buffalo, lay where they had choked to death, they said.
